description: T-4130: does Excel for the web open and compute a pivot's calculated items? It refuses every file whose pivot field lists a calculated item `f="1"` (FileCorruptTryRepair, pivots.md), so these sheets write the item `f="0"` to ask what the web does with the rest. Data!A1:D9 has Region, Product, Year and Sales: East A 2024 10, East A 2025 4, East B 2024 5, East B 2025 8, East C 2024 3, West A 2024 20, West A 2025 6, West B 2025 7 (Product sums A 40, B 20, C 3). Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product, Sum of Sales: CI0 a cache `<calculatedItems>` with AB = A+B (Excel's pivotArea, cacheIndex 1, naming the appended shared item AB) and the pivotField item AB `f="0"`; CIA0 the same with calculatedItem field 1 and a pivotArea writing every attribute (dataOnly 1, type normal, axis axisRow, field 1, offset A1, each reference flag 0); CF a calculated field Dbl = Sales*2+1 (data Sum of Sales and Sum of Dbl). Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
